text: This report responds to a request to report to Toronto and East York Community Council, in consultation with Toronto Hydro and the General Manager, Transportation Services, with an alternate strategy for re-location of hydro pole(s) located on the east side of Coxwell Avenue in Olde East York Village, in a staged plan with estimated costs and possible funding sources, to ensure that the sidewalk outside 1009 Coxwell Avenue meets the Vibrant Streets guidelines and ensures the sidewalk is accessible.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Received the report (June 19, 2018) from the Acting Director, Community Planning, Toronto and East York District, for information.
